recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered composition featuring a central trio of performers against a motion-blurred club background, framed by heavy horizontal bands containing bold, wide typography and a stylized manga-inspired mascot.
coreVisualRelationships: Triadic character arrangement with a central male figure flanked by two females with vibrant orange bob wigs.
Contrast between the photographic realism of the subjects and the flat, vector-based graphic headers.
Horizontal banding that separates the illustrative top section, the photographic middle, and the typographic footer.
Aggressive color palette dominated by saturated reds, oranges, and deep blacks.
coreInvariants: Motion-blurred background with red light streaks
Stylized cartoon mascot in the upper left corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a medium shot, centered horizontally, occupying the middle 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central male figure's intense gaze and the bright orange wigs of the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top header, moves down to the central trio, and settles on the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, light streaks, and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black providing the base for the photographic section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for hair and clothing accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Acid green and white for the primary header text to ensure legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds/oranges against crushed blacks; high value contrast in the white-outlined text.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weight with minimal contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized, sharp-edged characters for secondary scripts
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity of width across different weights and colors to maintain a cohesive Y2K tech aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical feel of the era.
Alternative for the secondary footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of three people (one man in center, two women with bright orange bob haircuts) in a dark club setting with red neon light streaks and motion blur. Leave a solid black bar at the top and bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line stacked title in the top right using an ultra-wide sans-serif with a green-to-white gradient and double outlines. Place a stylized, angry manga-style head in the top left. Add a single line of wide-tracked white text in the bottom black bar.

verificationChecks: Are the wigs a vibrant, saturated orange?
Is the background motion-blurred with red light?
Does the top header have a distinct graphic border?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red light streaks
Width of the horizontal text bars
Gradient colors of the main title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the heavy outlines.
Check that the orange hair doesn't blend too much into the red background.
Verify the horizontal banding is straight and clean.
Confirm the mascot does not resemble any copyrighted characters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast club photography with ultra-wide, outlined display type and a vector mascot to create a late-90s electronic music aesthetic.
